note: Synthetic, deterministic demo data for the POC. Signals, events, forecasts, asset telemetry, HR workflow figures and the prediction history are illustrative; none of it is read from a monitoring tool, CMDB, HR system or employee directory.

rate.label: Rate of change
rate.how: How fast the most deviated signal moved over the last readings, measured against the gap between its baseline and critical threshold.

correlated.label: Correlated signals
correlated.how: How many signal categories (infrastructure, application, database, network, business, user experience, capacity) are abnormal at the same time (5 or more scores 100).

business.label: Business impact
business.how: The service's business impact level (1-5), raised when its business-transaction signals are also abnormal.

changes.label: Recent changes
changes.how: A change, deployment or configuration event in the last 48 hours that touches the abnormal signals (suspected contributor, never a confirmed cause). More recent scores higher.

capacity.label: Capacity forecast
capacity.how: How soon the forecast says the service reaches its capacity limit (now scores 100; a week or more away scores 0).

reliability.label: Data reliability
reliability.how: Quality rating of the data sources behind the abnormal signals, scaled by how many independent categories agree. Unreliable or single-source evidence adds little.

sso.business_text: Every employee signs in through SSO: if sign-ins keep failing, staff across all 9 departments lose access to the Employee Center, claims and care-management tools.

signals.name: Identity provider CPU
signals.action: No action: the IdP servers are healthy.
Check token-service latency per relying party.
Read the token service error log for SAML assertion failures.
Separate bad-password failures from assertion/signature failures.

signals.action: Run the synthetic login journey manually and capture the SAML response.

signals.name: Login success rate
signals.action: Compare success rate by application to find the failing relying party.

signals.name: Employee Center sessions started per hour

changes.title: IdP SAML signing certificate rotation
changes.detail: New signing certificate activated on the identity provider; relying parties pull metadata every 24 hours.

hypotheses.text: Identity-provider configuration problem: the servers and network are healthy, but real and synthetic sign-ins fail. A signing-certificate or claim-mapping change is the likely area to check.
Token service slowing down under load.

payment.business_text: Claims payments, provider remittances and Finance payables run through the Payment API; failed or slow payments delay provider remittance.

signals.action: Check pay-gw-04 latency for the first request after idle.
Correlate 504s with idle periods on pooled connections.

signals.name: Firewall idle-session resets
signals.action: Compare the firewall idle timeout with the gateway pool idle eviction.

changes.title: Data centre firewall policy update
changes.detail: Idle TCP session timeout lowered from 60 to 30 minutes.

hypotheses.text: Pooled upstream connections are being dropped by the firewall while the gateway still reuses them: the first request after an idle period times out (HTTP 504).

portal.business_text: Employees raise HR and IT requests through the Employee Center; a slow portal delays requests and onboarding tasks but has workarounds.

signals.name: ec-db-02 database CPU

hypotheses.text: Database contention on ec-db-02 (the search index rebuild) is slowing portal pages.

vpn.business_text: About half of Point32Health staff work remotely or hybrid and need the VPN for internal tools.

signals.action: Check VPN gateway session load.
Check the ISP-A uplink and fail over to ISP-B if loss continues.

signals.action: Open a carrier ticket with ISP-A.

changes.detail: Carrier notice: route changes on the ISP-A circuit.

changes.title: VPN client 7.2 rollout to 30% of laptops

hypotheses.text: Packet loss on the ISP-A uplink is breaking VPN tunnels; the gateway itself is not the cause.

recurring.business_text: When the Workday integration fails, new-hire and employee updates stop flowing to ServiceNow and onboarding tasks stall.

signals.name: Integration service-account password expires in
signals.action: Rotate the credential now and move it to a vault with automatic rotation.

changes.title: Manual service-account password rotation (every ~30 days)
changes.detail: Last rotated 26 days ago; the password policy expires it after 30 days.

hypotheses.text: The integration's service-account password expires on a 30-day cycle; each expiry has caused a sync outage.

claims.business_text: Claims Operations processes about 5,000 claims an hour; a slowdown builds a backlog that delays provider payments and member claim status.

signals.action: Add claims API capacity temporarily while the cause is fixed.
Find the slowest claims API operations since release 24.11.

signals.action: Find long-running queries holding connections.

changes.title: Claims release 24.11 (includes a schema migration)
changes.detail: Deployed to the claims processing API; renames claim_line.member_id to member_ref.

changes.title: claims-api TLS certificate expires in 41 days

hypotheses.text: A database query regression after the latest release: slow queries hold connections, the pool fills, and claims API calls queue up, driving CPU and failures up.
The claims application servers are overloaded.

db.business_text: Claims adjudication waits on database connections; when the pool is exhausted, adjudication requests time out at the gateway.

signals.name: Database host CPU
signals.action: No action: the database host is not overloaded.
Raise the adjudication pool limit back to its tested value.

changes.title: claims-adjudication-api config release 24.11.2
changes.detail: Database pool maximum changed from 100 to 40 connections.

hypotheses.text: The connection pool is too small for peak volume: requests wait for a free connection while the database host itself is healthy and queries are fast.

capacity.business_text: Open enrollment drives member traffic up by about half; if the member API runs out of capacity, members can't check coverage or submit claims online.

signals.action: Raise the autoscaling maximum before open enrollment.

changes.title: Cost optimisation: member API autoscaling maximum 12 → 4 replicas
changes.detail: Approved cost change; replica cap lowered.

changes.title: Open enrollment opens
changes.detail: Expected member traffic +45-50% for two weeks.

hypotheses.text: The autoscaling cap leaves too little headroom for the open-enrollment peak: the forecast exceeds capacity before the event starts.
